<div id="power-demo" class="power-layout">

<div class="power-panel">

<label class="power-control">
<span>d</span>
<input
  data-param="effect"
  type="range"
  min="0.00"
  max="1.50"
  step="0.05"
  value="0.50">
<span data-value="effect"></span>
</label>

<label class="power-control">
<span>n</span>
<input
  data-param="n"
  type="range"
  min="5"
  max="200"
  step="1"
  value="30">
<span data-value="n"></span>
</label>

<label class="power-control">
<span>α</span>
<input
  data-param="alpha"
  type="range"
  min="0.001"
  max="0.500"
  step="0.001"
  value="0.050">
<span data-value="alpha"></span>
</label>

</div>


<div class="power-plot">
<svg></svg>
</div>

</div>

<script>
powerDemo("#power-demo", {
  xmin: -1.5,
  xmax: 3.0,
  height: 480
});
</script>
